description: Read federal lobbying filings and LDA.gov receipts. Uses the filters and plan limits of /api/v1/lobbying. Filings from commercial providers are excluded.
name: list_lobbying

outputSchema.description: A page of Lobbying Disclosure Act filings retrieved first-party from LDA.gov, with page-local counts, access, source attribution and cache contracts.

access.description: Verified access mode and its limits.

history_window.description: The current plan’s permitted filing or posting dates.

basis.description: Date used to enforce the plan window.

days.description: Free window length in UTC days.

from.description: First permitted date in the plan window, inclusive.

months.description: Developer window length in calendar months.

oge_from.description: First permitted date for OGE filings when the plan has a shorter OGE window.

through.description: Last permitted date in the plan window, inclusive.

max_window_days.description: Calendar days a request may read: 7 free, 31 Developer.

requests_per_hour_per_ip.description: Shared hourly anonymous disclosure budget per IP; omitted for Developer.

tier.description: Effective access mode. Only Developer keys page or read windows longer than 7 days.

cache.description: Executable delivery-cache contract matching the private no-store headers.

age_header.description: No Age header is promised because origin responses are private no-store.

browser_max_age_seconds.description: Browser cache lifetime in seconds: zero.

cdn_max_age_seconds.description: Shared CDN cache lifetime in seconds: zero.

declared_max_staleness_seconds.description: Delivery staleness allowance in seconds: zero; source instants remain distinct.

policy.description: Caller-specific origin response; not reusable by a browser or shared cache.

computed_at.description: This response's computation time. Page one pins it; later pages read only revisions retrieved at or before it.

coverage.description: Page-local counts. Completeness of the window against LDA.gov is not measured here.

basis.description: What population the page is drawn from and what is not measured.

additionalProperties.description: Filings withheld for this named reason.

measurement_scope.description: Counts describe only the rows read for this page.

revisions_collapsed.description: Older retained revisions read for this page and not served; only the newest retained revision of a filing is served.

rows_held.description: Filings read for this page but withheld because a check failed; counted, never silently dropped.

rows_returned.description: Filings returned in this response after caller filters.

data.description: Filings in this page, newest posting first.

items.description: One Lobbying Disclosure Act filing as posted by LDA.gov and retrieved by Veridion. Values are as filed.

client.description: The client on whose behalf the lobbying was reported. No company or ticker is inferred from the name.

lda_id.description: LDA.gov client identifier, as a string.

dt_posted.description: LDA.gov dt_posted exactly as published, with its original offset.

expenses.description: Lobbying expenses for the period as filed decimal text, in US dollars, reported by self-filing organizations; null when not reported.

expenses_method.description: Expense accounting method code as filed.

filing_period.description: Reporting period as filed, such as third_quarter.

filing_period_display.description: LDA.gov label for the reporting period.

filing_type.description: LDA.gov filing type code as filed, such as Q3, Q3Y, 3A or RR.

filing_type_display.description: LDA.gov label for the filing type.

filing_uuid.description: LDA.gov filing UUID; identifies the filing at LDA.gov.

income.description: Income from the client for the period as filed decimal text, in US dollars; null when the filer reported none.

lobbying_activities.description: Every lobbying activity on the filing, in filed order. Empty on registrations and no-activity reports.

items.description: One lobbying activity (issue area) reported on the filing.

description.description: Specific lobbying issues as the filer described them, verbatim.

foreign_entity_issues.description: Foreign entity interest text as filed; null when empty.

general_issue_code.description: Three-letter LDA general issue area code as filed.

general_issue_code_display.description: LDA.gov label for the general issue code.

government_entities.description: Houses of Congress and federal agencies the filer listed as contacted for this issue.

items.description: One government entity contacted, as named by LDA.gov.

lobbyists.description: Lobbyists the filer listed for this issue area.

items.description: One lobbyist listed on the activity, as filed.

covered_position.description: Covered official position the filer disclosed for this lobbyist, as filed; null when none was stated.

lda_id.description: LDA.gov lobbyist identifier as filed, as a string.

new.description: Whether the filer marked this lobbyist as new on this filing; null when not stated.

posted_at.description: When LDA.gov posted the filing (its dt_posted), as a UTC instant.

receipt.description: Where the filing can be read at LDA.gov and when Veridion retrieved it.

api_url.description: The LDA.gov API record Veridion retrieved.

filing_document_url.description: The filing's public LDA.gov print page.

receipt_id.description: Veridion identifier of the retained revision.

retrieved_at.description: When Veridion retrieved this revision from LDA.gov. Cite this date with the data, per LDA.gov terms.

sha256.description: SHA-256 Veridion computed at retrieval over the compact JSON of the LDA.gov record; identifies this retained revision.

registrant.description: The registrant that filed the report.

lda_id.description: LDA.gov registrant identifier, as a string.

name.description: Registrant (lobbying firm or self-filing organization) name as filed.

termination_date.description: Termination date as filed; null when the engagement was not terminated on this filing.

page.description: Keyset pagination within one pinned retrieval instant.

has_more.description: Another matching filing follows in the pinned population.

limit.description: Requested page size under the verified access mode.

next_cursor.description: Signed, query-bound position for the next Developer page, or null.

order.description: LDA.gov posting instant descending, then filing UUID descending; not a ranking.

source.description: Source attribution and the statement LDA.gov terms require.

disclaimer.const: Senate Office of Public Records cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from LDA.gov.
disclaimer.description: Statement required by LDA.gov terms, quoted exactly.

name.description: The system of record: the Lobbying Disclosure Act database published by the U.S. Senate Office of Public Records.

retrieval_basis.description: How the retrieval date is stated for each filing.

version.description: Served Disclosure API contract version, also sent as X-API-Version.

window.description: The posting window this response reads.

posted_since.description: First UTC calendar day of LDA.gov posting included.

posted_until.description: Last UTC calendar day of LDA.gov posting included.
